units.source_text: 男人真有些火了，真想强行扭住她的胳膊，把她摁倒在泥里。

en.t: The man was really getting angry, and he wanted to twist her arm by force and push her down into the mud.

units.source_text: 只不过想想，皮肤上就起了鸡皮疙瘩，

en.t: Just thinking about it made goose bumps rise on his skin,

units.source_text: 哗啦哗啦响起了揭掉干乎乎浆糊的声音。

en.t: and there came a crackling sound like dry paste being peeled away.

units.source_text: 因“扭住胳膊”一词，皮肤展开了随心所欲的联想。

en.t: Because of the phrase "twist her arm," his skin began spinning out associations of its own accord.

units.source_text: 忽然，女人同背景分离了开来，只剩一个轮廓存在着。

en.t: Suddenly, the woman separated from the background, and only an outline remained.

units.source_text: 二十岁的男人，靠观念发情。

en.t: A man in his twenties is aroused by ideas.

units.source_text: 四十岁的男人，靠皮肤的表面发情。

en.t: A man in his forties is aroused through the surface of the skin.

units.source_text: 可是，对三十岁的男人来说，变成轮廓的女人最危险。

en.t: But for a man in his thirties, a woman who has become an outline is the most dangerous of all.

units.source_text: ……简直就像抱住自己似的，可以毫无顾忌地抱住吧……

en.t: ...It would be almost like embracing himself; he could hold her without the slightest hesitation...

units.source_text: 但是，女人的背后生着许多眼睛……

en.t: But behind the woman, many eyes were growing...

units.source_text: 女人被那视线之丝操纵着，不过是受操纵的娃娃……

en.t: The woman was controlled by those threads of gazes, nothing more than a manipulated doll...

units.source_text: 要是抱住了女人，这回可就要轮到你被操纵了……

en.t: If you embrace the woman, then this time it will be your turn to be controlled...

units.source_text: “脊椎脱臼”，撒了个大谎，立刻就会露出马脚来。

en.t: "A dislocated spine"; if he told such a huge lie, he would immediately give himself away.

units.source_text: 已经过惯的生活，难道就此断送了吗！

en.t: Was he really going to throw away the life he had already grown used to?
